s0302.literal: Anbo and Ahuotai were both made privy council administrators.
s0302.idiomatic: Anbo and Ahuotai were both made privy council administrators.

s0303.literal: Rich and powerful households were forbidden to employ soldiers.
s0303.idiomatic: Rich and powerful households were forbidden to employ soldiers.

s0304.literal: An edict directed that enfeoffments and posthumous honors must not be memorialized except through the central secretariat.
s0304.idiomatic: An edict directed that enfeoffments and posthumous honors must not be memorialized except through the central secretariat.

s0305.literal: Heavy snow from Chenghai to the twelve northern frontier relay stations killed many horses and cattle; more than eleven thousand ingots of notes were granted.
s0305.idiomatic: Heavy snow from Chenghai to the 12 northern frontier relay stations killed many horses and cattle; more than 11,000 ingots of notes were granted.

s0306.literal: The censorate was ordered to inspect the records of the Xuanzheng Commission and the Monks' Directorate.
s0306.idiomatic: The censorate was ordered to inspect the records of the Xuanzheng Commission and the Monks' Directorate.

s0307.literal: The Imperial Medical Academy was promoted to rank two; Grand Councillor, Chief Protector of the Capital, and Supervisor of Imperial Medical Affairs Tuoyinna was made director of the Imperial Medical Academy.
s0307.idiomatic: The Imperial Medical Academy was promoted to rank two; grand councillor, chief protector of the capital, and supervisor of imperial medical affairs Tuoyinna was made director of the Imperial Medical Academy.

s0308.literal: Two hundred seventeen thousand four hundred ingots of notes were granted to artisans and others at Shangdu.
s0308.idiomatic: 217,400 ingots of notes were granted to artisans and others at Shangdu.

s0309.literal: Dadu, Baoding, Hejian, Jining, and Daming suffered flooding; Guangping and Zhending suffered locusts.
s0309.idiomatic: Dadu, Baoding, Hejian, Jining, and Daming suffered flooding; Guangping and Zhending suffered locusts.

s0310.literal: Eighth month, wuchen day: price payments for soldiers' sheep and horses and one hundred forty-three thousand ingots of notes for the Prince of Dingyuan's department were issued.
s0310.idiomatic: Eighth month, wuchen day: price payments for soldiers' sheep and horses and 143,000 ingots of notes for the Prince of Dingyuan's department were issued.

s0311.literal: On jisi day continuous rain in Pingluan Route caused the Luan, Qi, Fei, and Ru rivers to overflow; many commoners died; this year's field rent was remitted and thirty thousand shi of grain were issued for relief.
s0311.idiomatic: On jisi day continuous rain in Pingluan Route caused the Luan, Qi, Fei, and Ru rivers to overflow; many commoners died; this year's field rent was remitted and 30,000 shi of grain were issued for relief.

s0312.literal: On gengwu day Talatiemuer and others returned from Karakorum after rewarding the troops, saying: "Karakorum garrison farming should have military officers expand reclamation, issue agricultural implements as appropriate, and granary officers should be appointed from selected men — this can eliminate the abuse of embezzlement.
s0312.idiomatic: On gengwu day Talatiemuer and others returned from Karakorum after rewarding the troops, saying, "Karakorum garrison farming should have military officers expand reclamation, issue agricultural implements as appropriate, and granary officers should be appointed from selected men — this can eliminate the abuse of embezzlement.

s0314.literal: On jiaxu day Xue Chaowu'er and others were dispatched to lead troops against the Gold Teeth and other states; at that time the Burma expedition army was returning and was intercepted by the Gold Teeth — many soldiers died in battle.
s0314.idiomatic: On jiaxu day Xue Chaowu'er and others were dispatched to lead troops against the Gold Teeth and other states; at that time the Burma expedition army was returning and was intercepted by the Gold Teeth — many soldiers died in battle.

s0315.literal: Moreover the Eight Hundred Wives and various barbarians in succession followed suit in not paying taxes and levies, killing officials as bandits — therefore all were to be attacked.
s0315.idiomatic: Moreover the Eight Hundred Wives and various barbarians in succession followed suit in not paying taxes and levies, killing officials as bandits — therefore all were to be attacked.

s0316.literal: On gengchen day an edict directed: "Officials are to be dispatched by separate routes to give relief.
s0316.idiomatic: On gengchen day an edict directed, "Officials are to be dispatched by separate routes to give relief.

s0317.literal: All prisoners detained for years whose cases cannot be decided should have the surveillance commission report the doubtful circumstances and submit them to the secretariat and censorate for detailed adjudication, and this shall be made a standing regulation.
s0317.idiomatic: All prisoners detained for years whose cases cannot be decided should have the surveillance commission report the doubtful circumstances and submit them to the secretariat and censorate for detailed adjudication, and this shall be made a standing regulation.

s0318.literal: In every route severely afflicted by disaster, corvée taxes are remitted for one year; impoverished households receive relief counted by mouth; those especially severe receive preferential grants.
s0318.idiomatic: In every route severely afflicted by disaster, corvée taxes are remitted for one year; impoverished households receive relief counted by mouth; those especially severe receive preferential grants.

s0319.literal: Petty clerks guilty of embezzlement are all dismissed without further appointment.
s0319.idiomatic: Petty clerks guilty of embezzlement are all dismissed without further appointment.

s0320.literal: " Burma campaign wanhu Yelie Fushan and others presented six trained elephants.
s0320.idiomatic: Burma campaign wanhu Yelie Fushan and others presented six trained elephants.

s0321.literal: On renchen day the Moon transgressed the Maid of Xuan Yuan.
s0321.idiomatic: On renchen day the moon transgressed the Maid of Xuan Yuan.

s0322.literal: On yiwei day Saturn transgressed the Upper General of the Supreme Palace Enclosure.
s0322.idiomatic: On yiwei day Saturn transgressed the Upper General of the Supreme Palace Enclosure.

s0323.literal: Shunde Route suffered flooding; its field rent was remitted.
s0323.idiomatic: Shunde Route suffered flooding; its field rent was remitted.

s0324.literal: Ninth month, guichou day: Chenghai warehouse-guard troops were released to return, to be replaced in rotation.
s0324.idiomatic: Ninth month, guichou day: Chenghai warehouse-guard troops were released to return, to be replaced in rotation.

s0325.literal: On bingchen day Jiangling, Changde, and Li Prefecture all suffered drought; their stall, wine, and vinegar taxes were remitted.
s0325.idiomatic: On bingchen day Jiangling, Changde, and Li Prefecture all suffered drought; their stall, wine, and vinegar taxes were remitted.

s0326.literal: On yiyou day, from gengchen day of the eighth month a comet emerged at Well, passed through the Purple Forbidden Enclosure to the Celestial Market Enclosure — in all forty-six days then it vanished.
s0326.idiomatic: On yiyou day, from gengchen day of the eighth month a comet emerged at Well, passed through the Purple Forbidden Enclosure to the Celestial Market Enclosure — in all 46 days then it vanished.

s0327.literal: Winter, tenth month, bingyin new moon: because of famine within the metropolitan region, next year's sea-transport grain was increased to one million two hundred thousand shi.
s0327.idiomatic: Winter, tenth month, bingyin new moon: because of famine within the metropolitan region, next year's sea-transport grain was increased to 1,200,000 shi.

s0328.literal: On jisi day the king of Burma sent envoys with tribute.
s0328.idiomatic: On jisi day the king of Burma sent envoys with tribute.

s0329.literal: On wuyin day native official Qunze of Wuding Route in Yunnan presented local products.
s0329.idiomatic: On wuyin day native official Qunze of Wuding Route in Yunnan presented local products.

s0330.literal: On guimao day the Moon transgressed Eastern Well.
s0330.idiomatic: On guimao day the moon transgressed Eastern Well.

s0331.literal: On renwu day the imperial carriage returned to Dadu.
s0331.idiomatic: On renwu day the imperial carriage returned to Dadu.

s0332.literal: On bingxu day, because of famine, wine-brewing was forbidden; prohibitions on mountains and lakes were relaxed, and commoners were allowed to hunt.
s0332.idiomatic: On bingxu day, because of famine, wine-brewing was forbidden; prohibitions on mountains and lakes were relaxed, and commoners were allowed to hunt.

s0333.literal: Huguang branch secretariat officials said: "The Hainan and Haibei circuit pacification commissioner's headquarters of military commissioners does not participate in military affairs; when theft occurs, only documents are sent — by the time replies return, the affair is already beyond remedy; we now request that two of its chiefs be placed in charge of military affairs.
s0333.idiomatic: Huguang branch secretariat officials said, "The Hainan and Haibei circuit pacification commissioner's headquarters of military commissioners does not participate in military affairs; when theft occurs, only documents are sent — by the time replies return, the affair is already beyond remedy; we now request that two of its chiefs be placed in charge of military affairs.

s0334.literal: Moreover for garrison commanders who are negligent in merit, there is already a fixed regulation for punishment;
s0334.idiomatic: Moreover for garrison commanders who are negligent in merit, there is already a fixed regulation for punishment;

s0335.literal: for those who merit reward for achievement, we request that either supernumerary rank be added or gold or silver tallies be granted.
s0335.idiomatic: for those who merit reward for achievement, we request that either supernumerary rank be added or gold or silver tallies be granted.

s0337.literal: Garrison-farm fields in Nanyang Prefecture were allocated to newly registered Uighur households so they could farm for self-support; grain for three months was still issued.
s0337.idiomatic: Garrison-farm fields in Nanyang Prefecture were allocated to newly registered Uighur households so they could farm for self-support; grain for three months was still issued.

s0338.literal: On dinghai day an edict directed: "Military officers who after receiving appointment do not arrive on time, who on account of illness or death do not go, or who after assigned duties are finished do not promptly return — following the regulation for civilian officials, after six months in violation a replacement is selected; the replaced officer resumes rank after one year.
s0338.idiomatic: On dinghai day an edict directed, "Military officers who after receiving appointment do not arrive on time, who on account of illness or death do not go, or who after assigned duties are finished do not promptly return — following the regulation for civilian officials, after six months in violation a replacement is selected; the replaced officer resumes rank after one year.

s0339.literal: " Ezhou Route was changed to Wuchang Route.
s0339.idiomatic: Ezhou Route was changed to Wuchang Route.

s0340.literal: Envoys were dispatched to adjust officials in Yunnan, Sichuan, Fujian, Guangdong, and Guangxi, instructing all offices that matters pertaining to the central secretariat must not be memorialized presumptuously.
s0340.idiomatic: Envoys were dispatched to adjust officials in Yunnan, Sichuan, Fujian, Guangdong, and Guangxi, instructing all offices that matters pertaining to the central secretariat must not be memorialized presumptuously.

s0341.literal: Tenant households of powerful and influential families who borrowed grain were permitted to repay after the autumn harvest of the coming year.
s0341.idiomatic: Tenant households of powerful and influential families who borrowed grain were permitted to repay after the autumn harvest of the coming year.

s0342.literal: On guisi day troops of Diaomen, Li, and Ya were divided to garrison barbarian regions; Shaanxi garrison-farm wanhu Yebugan and others were ordered to lead them.
s0342.idiomatic: On guisi day troops of Diaomen, Li, and Ya were divided to garrison barbarian regions; Shaanxi garrison-farm wanhu Yebugan and others were ordered to lead them.

s0343.literal: On xinmao day at night a meteor as large as a cup, its light illuminating the ground, rose from the north near the east, divided into two stars, and set at the constellation Rooftop.
s0343.idiomatic: On xinmao day at night a meteor as large as a cup, its light illuminating the ground, rose from the north near the east, divided into two stars, and set at the constellation Rooftop.

s0344.literal: Eleventh month, jihai day: Jupiter transgressed Eastern Well; an edict addressed the central secretariat: recently because of the wine prohibition, it was heard that elderly persons needing wine had pre-purchased and stored it — those without brewing equipment should not be questioned.
s0344.idiomatic: Eleventh month, jihai day: Jupiter transgressed Eastern Well; an edict addressed the central secretariat: recently because of the wine prohibition, it was heard that elderly persons needing wine had pre-purchased and stored it — those without brewing equipment should not be questioned.

s0345.literal: Hunan transport commission's Hongzhou farming promotion office was abolished and its affairs transferred to the regular offices.
s0345.idiomatic: Hunan transport commission's Hongzhou farming promotion office was abolished and its affairs transferred to the regular offices.

s0346.literal: Rong, Xiang, Heng, and Bin routes were reduced to prefectures; Pingluan gold and cinnabar promotion office was reduced to an overseer; Zhao Prefecture was promoted to Pingle Prefecture; Mi County was annexed into Tang Prefecture.
s0346.idiomatic: Rong, Xiang, Heng, and Bin routes were reduced to prefectures; Pingluan gold and cinnabar promotion office was reduced to an overseer; Zhao Prefecture was promoted to Pingle Prefecture; Mi County was annexed into Tang Prefecture.

s0347.literal: On dingwei day Liu Guojie and Yesian Hudul were dispatched to lead ten thousand troops; Bala and Ataqchi to lead five thousand troops — to campaign against Song Longji.
s0347.idiomatic: On dingwei day Liu Guojie and Yesian Hudul were dispatched to lead 10,000 troops; Bala and Ataqchi to lead 5,000 troops — to campaign against Song Longji.

s0348.literal: Grain was sold at reduced price to relieve the poor of the capital; thirty-six shops were established; those elderly, young, solitary, or weak who could not support themselves received granary provisions for five months.
s0348.idiomatic: Grain was sold at reduced price to relieve the poor of the capital; 36 shops were established; those elderly, young, solitary, or weak who could not support themselves received granary provisions for five months.

s0349.literal: Han army bodyguard troops of the Six Guards were selected for military training; also forbidden that subordinates below wanhu be privately replaced — offenders sentenced according to gradations.
s0349.idiomatic: Han army bodyguard troops of the Six Guards were selected for military training; also forbidden that subordinates below wanhu be privately replaced — offenders sentenced according to gradations.

s0350.literal: On wushen day the Moon transgressed Hairy Head.
s0350.idiomatic: On wushen day the moon transgressed Hairy Head.

s0351.literal: Yao tribesman Lan Lai led the thirty-six caves of Danyang in submission; Lan Lai and others were made registrars and marshals of Huaiyuan County in Rong Prefecture.
s0351.idiomatic: Yao tribesman Lan Lai led the 36 caves of Danyang in submission; Lan Lai and others were made registrars and marshals of Huaiyuan County in Rong Prefecture.

s0352.literal: Changxin Temple was established at rank three.
s0352.idiomatic: Changxin Temple was established at rank three.

s0353.literal: Twelfth month, jiaxu day: Jupiter transgressed Oddities.
s0353.idiomatic: Twelfth month, jiaxu day: Jupiter transgressed Oddities.

s0354.literal: Rations were issued to soldiers under the Prince of Anxi; each was ordered to return home and await spring mobilization.
s0354.idiomatic: Rations were issued to soldiers under the Prince of Anxi; each was ordered to return home and await spring mobilization.

s0355.literal: On xinmao day the Moon transgressed Southern Dipper.
s0355.idiomatic: On xinmao day the moon transgressed Southern Dipper.

s0356.literal: Eastern Expedition branch secretariat pingzhang Kuolijisi was dismissed for inability to harmonize with Koryo.
s0356.idiomatic: Eastern Expedition branch secretariat pingzhang Kuolijisi was dismissed for inability to harmonize with Koryo.

s0357.literal: Regulations on robbery and theft were fixed: whoever steals another's livestock pays ninefold compensation, then receives beating.
s0357.idiomatic: Regulations on robbery and theft were fixed: whoever steals another's livestock pays ninefold compensation, then receives beating.

s0358.literal: That year Bianliang, Guide, Nanyang, Deng Prefecture, Tang Prefecture, Chen Prefecture, He Prefecture, Xiangyang, Runing, Gaoyou, Yangzhou, and Changzhou suffered locusts; Xizhou, Suizhou, Anling, Jingmen, Taizhou, Guang Prefecture, Yangzhou, Chuzhou, Gaoyou, and Anfeng suffered excessive rain; Fengqiu, Yangwu, Lanyang, Zhongmu, and Yanjin in Bianliang, Mianchi in Henan, Qichun, Guangji, and Qishui in Qizhou suffered drought; Daming, Xuande, Fengsheng, Guide, Ninghai, Jining, Panyang, Dengzhou, Laizhou, Yidu, Weizhou, Boxing, Dongping, Jinan, Binzhou, Baoding, Hejian, Zhending, and Daning suffered flooding.
s0358.idiomatic: That year Bianliang, Guide, Nanyang, Deng Prefecture, Tang Prefecture, Chen Prefecture, He Prefecture, Xiangyang, Runing, Gaoyou, Yangzhou, and Changzhou suffered locusts; Xizhou, Suizhou, Anling, Jingmen, Taizhou, Guang Prefecture, Yangzhou, Chuzhou, Gaoyou, and Anfeng suffered excessive rain; Fengqiu, Yangwu, Lanyang, Zhongmu, and Yanjin in Bianliang, Mianchi in Henan, Qichun, Guangji, and Qishui in Qizhou suffered drought; Daming, Xuande, Fengsheng, Guide, Ninghai, Jining, Panyang, Dengzhou, Laizhou, Yidu, Weizhou, Boxing, Dongping, Jinan, Binzhou, Baoding, Hejian, Zhending, and Daning suffered flooding.

s0359.literal: That year sixty-one persons were sentenced to death.
s0359.idiomatic: That year 61 persons were sentenced to death.

s0360.literal: Sixth year, spring, first month, guimao day, edict: qianhu, baihu, and others who desert and return from the army — those who flee beforehand are punished by death; those who flee after defeat are beaten and dismissed, their male and female dependents confiscated.
s0360.idiomatic: Sixth year, spring, first month, guimao day, edict: qianhu, baihu, and others who desert and return from the army — those who flee beforehand are punished by death; those who flee after defeat are beaten and dismissed, their male and female dependents confiscated.

s0361.literal: On yisi day central secretariat officials said: "Guangdong pacification vice commissioner Tuohuancha'er in capturing bandits and robbers repeatedly had meritorious achievements; recently the surveillance commission impeached him for privately setting up arms, summarily killing local bandits, and other matters; officials were dispatched to interrogate — in fact there was no private crime; we request increased reward and encouragement.
s0361.idiomatic: On yisi day central secretariat officials said, "Guangdong pacification vice commissioner Tuohuancha'er in capturing bandits and robbers repeatedly had meritorious achievements; recently the surveillance commission impeached him for privately setting up arms, summarily killing local bandits, and other matters; officials were dispatched to interrogate — in fact there was no private crime; we request increased reward and encouragement.

s0362.literal: " Two sets of garments were granted.
s0362.idiomatic: Two sets of garments were granted.

s0363.literal: Prince of Jin Gammala died; the princely seal and inner secretariat seal were ordered sealed.
s0363.idiomatic: Prince of Jin Gammala died; the princely seal and inner secretariat seal were ordered sealed.

s0364.literal: On bingwu day twenty-one relay stations in the metropolitan region lacked provisions; more than twelve thousand seven hundred ingots of notes were granted.
s0364.idiomatic: On bingwu day 21 relay stations in the metropolitan region lacked provisions; more than 12,700 ingots of notes were granted.

s0365.literal: Shaanxi suffered drought; commoners were forbidden to brew wine.
s0365.idiomatic: Shaanxi suffered drought; commoners were forbidden to brew wine.

s0366.literal: Because Yunnan relay households were impoverished, horses and notes were increased for preferential relief.
s0366.idiomatic: Because Yunnan relay households were impoverished, horses and notes were increased for preferential relief.

s0367.literal: Central secretariat officials, because Zhu Qing and Zhang Xuan repeatedly drew public comment, requested their dismissal from office and transfer of their sons holding office in Jiangnan to the capital.
s0367.idiomatic: Central secretariat officials, because Zhu Qing and Zhang Xuan repeatedly drew public comment, requested their dismissal from office and transfer of their sons holding office in Jiangnan to the capital.

s0368.literal: On dingwei day Zhejiang pingzhang Ali was ordered to take exclusive charge of that province's revenues.
s0368.idiomatic: On dingwei day Zhejiang pingzhang Ali was ordered to take exclusive charge of that province's revenues.

s0369.literal: On gengxu day an edict directed that officials guilty of crimes already amnestied are still to be investigated and questioned.
s0369.idiomatic: On gengxu day an edict directed that officials guilty of crimes already amnestied are still to be investigated and questioned.

s0370.literal: Sea-route transport grain ships were ordered to have tammaq troops and Jiangnan sailors jointly trained to guard against sea bandits.
s0370.idiomatic: Sea-route transport grain ships were ordered to have tammaq troops and Jiangnan sailors jointly trained to guard against sea bandits.

s0371.literal: Jiangnan monk Shi Zujin reported ten illegal acts of Zhu Qing and Zhang Xuan; the censorate was ordered to interrogate them.
s0371.idiomatic: Jiangnan monk Shi Zujin reported ten illegal acts of Zhu Qing and Zhang Xuan; the censorate was ordered to interrogate them.

s0372.literal: The Emperor said to censorate officials: "We have heard that rich households in Jiangnan encroach on commoners' fields, causing the poor to drift away and migrate — have you heard of this?
s0372.idiomatic: The Emperor said to censorate officials, "We have heard that rich households in Jiangnan encroach on commoners' fields, causing the poor to drift away and migrate — have you heard of this?

s0373.literal: " Censorate officials said: "Rich households frequently request protective imperial letters and rely on them to defraud poor commoners; government offices cannot investigate and punish — it would be convenient to recover them all.
s0373.idiomatic: Censorate officials said, "Rich households frequently request protective imperial letters and rely on them to defraud poor commoners; government offices cannot investigate and punish — it would be convenient to recover them all.

s0374.literal: " Ordered to implement immediately, not to exceed three days.
s0374.idiomatic: Ordered to implement immediately, not to exceed three days.

s0375.literal: An edict directed that from now on when Buddhist officials and monks commit crimes, the censorate and the internal and external Xuanzheng commission jointly try them; where Xuanzheng commission officials show favoritism and injustice, the censorate is permitted to punish them.
s0375.idiomatic: An edict directed that from now on when Buddhist officials and monks commit crimes, the censorate and the internal and external Xuanzheng commission jointly try them; where Xuanzheng commission officials show favoritism and injustice, the censorate is permitted to punish them.

s0376.literal: Prince Tachi Temur's annual grant was increased by two hundred fifty taels of silver and one hundred bolts of miscellaneous silks.
s0376.idiomatic: Prince Tachi Temur's annual grant was increased by 250 taels of silver and 100 bolts of miscellaneous silks.

s0377.literal: On yimao day the Hun River dike was built eighty li long; powerful households were forbidden from encroaching on the old river channel; garrison-farm troops and commoners were ordered to plant fields.
s0377.idiomatic: On yimao day the Hun River dike was built 80 li long; powerful households were forbidden from encroaching on the old river channel; garrison-farm troops and commoners were ordered to plant fields.

s0378.literal: Liu Guojie's army was augmented; still ordered to garrison strategic passes until autumn when the army would advance.
s0378.idiomatic: Liu Guojie's army was augmented; still ordered to garrison strategic passes until autumn when the army would advance.

s0379.literal: Zhahu'erdai, Ali, and others were ordered to rectify those in Jiangnan who covertly occupied tax-paying commoners' land.
s0379.idiomatic: Zhahu'erdai, Ali, and others were ordered to rectify those in Jiangnan who covertly occupied tax-paying commoners' land.

s0380.literal: Central secretariat officials said: "The censorate and surveillance commissions — field inspection and on-site verification — have differed before and after.
s0380.idiomatic: Central secretariat officials said, "The censorate and surveillance commissions — field inspection and on-site verification — have differed before and after.

s0381.literal: When the censorate was first established, only field inspection was used; later when the surveillance commission was established, matters great and small were all subject to on-site verification.
s0381.idiomatic: When the censorate was first established, only field inspection was used; later when the surveillance commission was established, matters great and small were all subject to on-site verification.

s0382.literal: Consequently censorate affairs accumulated without being carried out.
s0382.idiomatic: Consequently censorate affairs accumulated without being carried out.

s0383.literal: We request that from now on, aside from flood, drought, and disaster damage using on-site verification, the remainder follow the old regulation of field inspection as appropriate.
s0383.idiomatic: We request that from now on, aside from flood, drought, and disaster damage using on-site verification, the remainder follow the old regulation of field inspection as appropriate.

s0385.literal: Because Dadu, Pingluan, and other routes were afflicted by water last year, troops due to go to Shangdu for summer residence were exempted from mobilization for one year.
s0385.idiomatic: Because Dadu, Pingluan, and other routes were afflicted by water last year, troops due to go to Shangdu for summer residence were exempted from mobilization for one year.

s0386.literal: An edict directed that military officers, aside from distant frontier campaigns, when encountering mourning for grandparents or parents follow civilian official regulations with fixed limits for departure.
s0386.idiomatic: An edict directed that military officers, aside from distant frontier campaigns, when encountering mourning for grandparents or parents follow civilian official regulations with fixed limits for departure.

s0387.literal: Raising hawks, dogs, horses, camels, and the like to disturb the people was forbidden.
s0387.idiomatic: Raising hawks, dogs, horses, camels, and the like to disturb the people was forbidden.

s0388.literal: On yiwei day, because Prince Zhentong falsely accused the Prince of Jinan, he was demoted and placed in Liu Guojie's army to redeem himself.
s0388.idiomatic: On yiwei day, because Prince Zhentong falsely accused the Prince of Jinan, he was demoted and placed in Liu Guojie's army to redeem himself.

s0389.literal: On renxu day Saturn transgressed the Upper General of the Supreme Palace Enclosure.
s0389.idiomatic: On renxu day Saturn transgressed the Upper General of the Supreme Palace Enclosure.

s0390.literal: Second month, gengwu day: the Moon transgressed Hairy Head.
s0390.idiomatic: Second month, gengwu day: the moon transgressed Hairy Head.

s0391.literal: Prince Bolo was demoted to serve in the Sichuan Bala army to redeem himself.
s0391.idiomatic: Prince Bolo was demoted to serve in the Sichuan Bala army to redeem himself.

s0392.literal: On guiyou day Prince Chubo's army was increased by three thousand men, each supplied with two horses at government expense.
s0392.idiomatic: On guiyou day Prince Chubo's army was increased by 3,000 men, each supplied with two horses at government expense.

s0393.literal: On bingxu day Shaanxi branch secretariat pingzhang Yesudai'er and associate administrator Wang Weiqi were dispatched to lead Sichuan and Shaanxi armies; Huguang pingzhang Liu Guojie to lead Huguang armies — to campaign against Yiqibuxie; all military affairs were placed under Yesudai'er and Liu Guojie's command.
s0393.idiomatic: On bingxu day Shaanxi branch secretariat pingzhang Yesudai'er and associate administrator Wang Weiqi were dispatched to lead Sichuan and Shaanxi armies; Huguang pingzhang Liu Guojie to lead Huguang armies — to campaign against Yiqibuxie; all military affairs were placed under Yesudai'er and Liu Guojie's command.

s0394.literal: Right vice chancellor Liu Shen and others of the Eight Hundred Wives campaign were dismissed; their tallies, seals, and relay vouchers were confiscated.
s0394.idiomatic: Right vice chancellor Liu Shen and others of the Eight Hundred Wives campaign were dismissed; their tallies, seals, and relay vouchers were confiscated.

s0395.literal: Because the capital's people lacked food, the secretariat and censorate were ordered to dispatch officials to count mouths and verify; more than one hundred seventeen thousand one hundred ingots of notes were issued for relief.
s0395.idiomatic: Because the capital's people lacked food, the secretariat and censorate were ordered to dispatch officials to count mouths and verify; more than 117,100 ingots of notes were issued for relief.

s0396.literal: On guisi day the Emperor fell ill; thirty-eight serious prisoners in the capital were released.
s0396.idiomatic: On guisi day the Emperor fell ill; 38 serious prisoners in the capital were released.

s0397.literal: Third month, dingyou day: because of drought and flooding as disasters, an edict granted amnesty throughout the realm.
s0397.idiomatic: Third month, dingyou day: because of drought and flooding as disasters, an edict granted amnesty throughout the realm.

s0398.literal: Dadu and Pingluan were especially severely afflicted — their corvée taxes remitted for three years; other disaster-afflicted places already relieved remitted for one year.
s0398.idiomatic: Dadu and Pingluan were especially severely afflicted — their corvée taxes remitted for three years; other disaster-afflicted places already relieved remitted for one year.

s0399.literal: This year's inner-circuit package silver, salary notes, summer tax south of the Yangtze and Huai, and villager household stall taxes in every route were all remitted.
s0399.idiomatic: This year's inner-circuit package silver, salary notes, summer tax south of the Yangtze and Huai, and villager household stall taxes in every route were all remitted.

s0400.literal: On renyin day the Moon transgressed Ghost.
s0400.idiomatic: On renyin day the moon transgressed Ghost.
